articles.title: Hungary’s ruling party backs chess legend Judit Polgar for President
articles.summary: Prime Minister Peter Magyar said that he would ask Ms. Polgar, widely regarded as the ‌greatest ever female chess player, to take up the largely ceremonial role of President until ‌a new constitution is passed Hungary’s ruling party backs chess legend Judit Polgar for President.

articles.title: Russian And Ukraine Exchange Overnight Strikes As Drone Attacks Target Moscow Region
articles.summary: Large plumes of black smoke rose high into the skies of the Moscow region on July 20 after Ukrainian drone strikes hit an oil depot and logistics facilities, wounding 10 people as Kyiv vowed to respond to deadly Russian attacks that have left several people dead. articles.title: Haiti endures violence and hunger, but hopes grow for a more secure future
articles.summary: After years of violence perpetrated by gangs, widespread insecurity and the displacement of almost 1.5 million people as well as growing humanitarian needs, Haitians are glimpsing signs of hope as a path to democratic elections begins to emerge. articles.title: A former Ferrari boss has a blunt message: Your commute is more dangerous than his old job
articles.summary: Jean Todt spent decades around the deadliest motorsport on Earth. He was a rally co‑driver, then ran Ferrari’s Formula One team, then became president of world motorsport’s governing body. In his early years, a driver dying at the track barely made news. A former Ferrari boss has a blunt message: Your commute is more dangerous than his old job.

articles.title: 'Sooner Or Later This Problem Will Be On Your Soil': Estonia Pushes Europe To Bar Russian Fighters
articles.summary: As Russia's war against Ukraine reshapes Europe's security landscape, Estonia is closely watching the Kremlin's next moves. articles.title: 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia
articles.summary: Joosep Kaasik, the undersecretary for internal security in Estonia's Ministry of the Interior, told RFE/RL in an interview that his country takes the threat of a potential Russian attack seriously, but is also prepared to deal with the use of soft power by its Eastern neighbor. 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia.

articles.title: ‘We are preserving a tradition’: how Ghana’s sensationalist film posters became collectible art
articles.summary: Hand-painted works are often wildly unfaithful to the movies they portray – reinterpretations that sometimes resulted in threats, insults and even physical attacks from viewers who felt dupedSitting on his porch in Teshie near Accra, Heavy J dipped a brush into red oil paint and dabbed it carefully on to his canvas – a flour sack – adding blood to a knife being wielded by a man.

articles.title: New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States
articles.summary: US strikes on Iran widened early on July 18 from the Strait of Hormuz hotspot to multiple sites throughout central and southern Iran, including through the use of fighter jets, while Iran continued to pound US Gulf allies, as a fragile cease-fire further tattered. New US Attacks On Roads, Bridges Reported As Iran Hits Back At Gulf States.

articles.title: Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life
articles.summary: It looks like a regular coffee shop, albeit set up in an old red bus. Stairs lead up to a serving hatch, with a menu of drink options. A selection of jaunty coffee-related messages like “My one and only love: Americano” and “Miss you a latte,” adorn the side of the bus. Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life.

articles.title: UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas
articles.summary: The UN Secretary-General remains deeply concerned by the continuing deadly military escalation between Iran and the United States, his spokesperson said on Friday as attacks destroyed key civilian and military infrastructure across the Gulf region. UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas.

articles.title: Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike
articles.summary: More than 256,000 people in Djibouti – around 25 per cent of the population – are likely to face crisis or emergency level hunger over the coming months, a UN-backed global food monitoring network warned in a new report released Friday. Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike.

articles.title: Thunderstorms strike across Europe amid record heatwave
articles.summary: Storms are typical during intense heat but this week’s have been extreme. Plus, deadly monsoon rains in BangladeshHailstones the size of golf balls have been seen in French villages as, on top of the exceptional European heatwave, thunderstorms have struck across parts of Europe. Thunderstorms strike across Europe amid record heatwave.

articles.title: Uganda calls for travel restrictions to be lifted after last Ebola patient discharged
articles.summary: Country begins 42-day countdown to outbreak being declared officially over, as numbers continue to rise in neighbouring Democratic Republic of the CongoUganda has started lobbying countries to lift Ebola-related travel restrictions after discharging its last confirmed Ebola patient from hospital. The discharge of a Congolese national from the Mulago national referral hospital’s isolation centre in Uganda calls for travel restrictions to be lifted after last Ebola patient discharged.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. articles.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
articles.summary: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab.

articles.summary: David Lammy Resignation: ब्रिटेन में सत्ता परिवर्तन के बाद कैबिनेट में बड़ा फेरबदल शुरू हो गया है। पूर्व पीएम कीर स्टार्मर के इस्तीफे के बाद प्रधानमंत्री बने एंडी बर्नहम ने अपनी नई टीम का गठन शुरू कर दिया है। इसी क्रम में उप-प्रधानमंत्री डेविड लैमी ने सोमवार को सरकार से इस्तीफा दे दिया। उन्होंने कहा कि नए प्रधानमंत्री को अपनी पसंद की टीम बनाने का पूरा अधिकार है और वह अब सांसद के रूप में लेबर सरकार।

articles.summary: Masoud Pezeshkian: ईरान के राष्ट्रपति मसूद पेजेशकियन ने कहा है कि उनका देश अमेरिका के साथ ‘फुल स्केल वॉर’ की स्थिति में है। उन्होंने कहा कि यह लड़ाई केवल मिसाइलों तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि अब अर्थव्यवस्था और लोगों की आजीविका भी इस संघर्ष का हिस्सा बन चुकी है। साथ ही उन्होंने माना कि राष्ट्रीय हितों की रक्षा की इस राह पर ईरान को इसके स्वाभाविक परिणाम भी स्वीकार करने होंगे।

articles.title: कौन है खलील अल-हय्या? जो बना हमास का नया नेता, लेगा याह्या सिनवार की जगह, गाजा से 2064 KM दूर क्यों
articles.summary: करीब दो साल से जारी गाजा युद्ध के बीच फिलिस्तीनी संगठन हमास ने अपना नया सर्वोच्च नेता चुन लिया है. हमास ने खालिल अल-हय्या को अपना नया प्रमुख नियुक्त किया है. खालिल अल-हय्या ऐसे समय में हमास की कमान संभाल रहे हैं, जब संगठन अपने कई बड़े नेताओं को खो चुका है. अल-हय्या ने याह्या सिनवार की जगह ली है. सिनवार 2024 में गाजा में इजरायली सेना के साथ लड़ाई के दौरान मारे गए थे.
